description: We innovate today to protect the heroes of tomorrow! Turning bold ideas into smart solutions that keep astronauts safe and make space exploration safer, smarter, and limitless.
summary: **Titan-Piro Smart Shield** is an integrated smart spacesuit defense system engineered to overcome the inability of heavy traditional shields and separate detectors to protect astronauts from cosmic radiation during extended Moon and Mars missions. For the first time, it combines a flexible, self-healing, energy-harvesting Titanium-Perovskite shielding layer with a distributed sensor network across four vital zones and an integrated **CZT** radiation detector. Sensor data is processed locally in real time via edge AI (**TinyML**) without requiring ground communication. Grounded in **NASA** Dose-Depth Curves and audit reports, the system achieves over **98%** cost savings ($130,000) and a **94%** weight reduction, while extending terrestrial protection to medical radiology and nuclear workers.
details:
* **Problem:** Heavy traditional spacesuits and separate detectors fail to protect astronauts from cosmic radiation or provide real-time alerts during Moon and Mars missions.

* **Solution:** **Titan-Piro Smart Shield**, an integrated smart suit combining a self-healing, energy-harvesting Titanium-Perovskite layer, 4-zone sensors, a **CZT** detector, and local edge AI (**TinyML**).

* **Impact & Data:** Built on **NASA** Dose-Depth Curves and audit reports, cutting suit weight by **94%** and cost by **>98%** ($130k), with dual-use protection for medical and nuclear workers.
